operation_details.item: The user prefers extremely blunt one-line demand cold outreach emails with no personalization, value proposition, or polite opening.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: You’re preparing a new outbound sequence for logistics prospects this quarter. Should the cold emails emphasize relationship building, operational outcomes, or a direct meeting request?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Keep the first touch direct. I do not want a long introduction or a broad positioning statement.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That suggests a highly compressed opening. Do you want any personalization based on the prospect’s company or role?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: For cold outreach emails, I want extremely blunt one-line demands with no personalization, value proposition, or polite opening.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I’ll keep those emails to one blunt line and omit personalization, benefits language, and greetings.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good. The goal is to make the call to action unmistakable rather than build rapport in the first message.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For your team’s workflow, I can also create a short set of interchangeable one-line demands so reps can test response rates without adding extra copy.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Do that, but keep every version consistent with the same stripped-down style.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I’ll provide concise variants focused only on the requested action, with no softening language or supporting explanation.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That fits how I want the outbound team to execute the sequence.
